steps.caption: Choose five files at once: a brochure PDF, site-visit notes in Word, two contact lists and an old 2019 .xls tracker.
The batch page. Files are processed in the background — you can keep working; this page updates by itself.
The old .xls failed straight away: old format. Save it as .xlsx and add it again — the original is kept.
Progress: files are read one by one…
Documents go to capture for extraction; spreadsheets to the import engine.
Completion report: files received, processed, partly processed, failed; records identified, created and linked; duplicates, conflicts and items to review.
'Partly processed' means a document has items waiting for your review — open its extraction review.
Baner availability.xlsx failed for a temporary reason (a timeout), so it can be retried.
One failed file never undoes another file's results.
Press 'Retry 1 failed file'. Only failed files are tried again.
After the retry it is processed; reload to see the new status.
'Open import report' shows that file's own mapping, validation and rows.
All imports keeps every batch with its report.
